limitations: This corpus is a convenience sample of locally available repositories. It is not a sample of the software industry, and a share computed from it is not a market share.
A library absent from this table was not observed in this corpus. That is not evidence that it is rare, niche, or specialised; most libraries in existence are absent.
Counts are per repository, not per download, per commit, or per user. A library declared by one widely used repository counts once.
corpus.selection_note: Locally available repositories on one developer machine: a corpus cache of public GitHub projects plus a hand-selected OSS slice. Selected for availability, not sampled from any population.
